We cannot process invoice INV-1008 (dated 2026-01-10, total 9,900.00 USD). Acme Corp Accounts Payable"}
message.reasoning_content:
Closing out the rejected invoice.

The policy requires a return_to_vendor disposition. The invoice contains an unknown item and near-threshold total, so the vendor must correct these issues before resubmitting.

MegaSprocket is also catalog unknown. NoProd Industries is not on file. The audit log will cite the finding IDs. A short email to the vendor's billing team will list each problem with numbers and required corrections.

The vendor email will ask them to correct SuperGizmo and MegaSprocket to catalog items. It will not mention internal thresholds or stock levels.

The email will cite exact quantities and prices for each rejected item. The vendor master issue may also need to be addressed.

The line amounts are null, but the total of 9,900.00 is mathematically correct. The rejection is strictly for unknown catalog items. The vendor email will cite SuperGizmo at quantity 12 and price 400, and MegaSprocket at quantity 6 and price 850. It will ask them to resubmit with recognized catalog descriptions.
